notes: Three places I expect a shared-prior misread. (1) 'Reload 40%.' — the natural reading is a reload-SPEED buff; the faithful primitive is instantReload {fraction:0.4} at FB entry, and the test must assert the ABSENCE of a reloadSpeedPct buffApply, not just some reload-related effect. (2) The heals are tandem-load-bearing, not skippable: crown is the fixed B2 in controlComp and consumes 'recovery' triggers, so both the 60-hit heal and the burst heal must emit team-targeted heal events — a driver who pruned them as defensive goes silently green on damage totals while crown's uptime is wrong. (3) FIXTURE HAZARD: this unit is Burst I with a 40s cooldown, and controlComp pins liter (also B1) into the comp while placing the audited unit in the 'carry' slot. Burst-selection is first-ready-in-window, so it is entirely possible alice-wonderland-bunny NEVER casts her burst in the default fixture (liter's shorter cd wins every rotation) — every burst-slot assertion would then pass vacuously. The driver must positively assert she casts at least once (count her burstCast events > 0) or construct a comp where she is the only ready B1; a vacuously-green burst suite is the failure mode here. Also: her reenterStage-1 double-cast adds a ~30f stage repeat to the chain, so FB timing shifts slightly on rotations she casts — rotation assertions should tolerate that, and the skill2 gauge buff (fullBurstEnd) plus reenterStage jointly move FB cadence, so judge them by FB-count/rotation-log assertions, not damage totals. Carrot Party's only live function is carrying stack state for a gate whose payload is itself unmodeled — it must still be asserted INERT on the partless boss (partsDamagePct, not a generic damage stat).
